summary: PM2b: one copy of each plugin DLL; Sdk assembly version = plugin API
description:
Landed in:
- DevHub `3292a1c`: PM2b: one copy of each plugin DLL — Pack-Plugin.ps1 leaves out the DLLs of required plugins from this repo; marketplace folders load requirements first (PluginResolver.RequirementsFirst, tested), so the required plugin's own DLLs win; Sdk assembly version = plugin API version (N.0.0.0), so plugins built against a newer Sdk load in an older DevHub and in dev builds
